_finding: The guard is what stands between an agent and a fake stock token. It must refuse when it could not check (failing open would let every trade through during an outage), refuse an impostor, and refuse a listed token of a different stock from the one asked for.

mutations.name: the guard fails open by default
mutations.expect: FAIL a registry that cannot be read refuses the buy

mutations.name: an impostor is allowed
mutations.expect: FAIL a token copying a listed symbol is refused

mutations.name: the claimed stock is not compared
mutations.expect: FAIL a listed token of ANOTHER stock than the one asked for is refused
